value.scope: CPU-only reading of original real root-tape B4 traces; no new profile, GPU call or model

analysis.scope: Existing CPU runtime intervals only. CPU inclusive duration, device copy duration and other CPU op inclusive duration overlap; never add them as elapsed time or call every synchronization a specific GPU wait.
analysis.cpu_owner_rule: At runtime CPU start, original same-pid/tid innermost cpu_op and annotation intervals; full actual ancestor chains retained. External-id owner is reported separately; missing/ambiguous or differing links are not silently replaced.
analysis.copy_link_rule: Unique runtime correlation to original gpu_memcpy events, otherwise exact one-to-one memcpy API/device External id; no size, direction or waiting-work guesses.
